_warning: GENERATED FILE - DO NOT EDIT. Built from the CSV by scripts/data/build-data.mjs; edits are lost on the next build. Edit the CSV, then run: npm run data:build

cartridge_name.note: Cartridge designation exactly as the compiler prints it. Joined to cartridge_specs.slug via the loader's name index, so a spelling change orphans the row rather than silently creating a new cartridge.

saami_piezo_ksi.note: SAAMI maximum piezo pressure, ksi. Blank where the cartridge is not SAAMI-listed.

cip_piezo_ksi.note: CIP maximum piezo pressure, ksi. Blank where not CIP-listed.

saami_cup.note: SAAMI maximum pressure in cup of copper (c.u.p.). Blank where not SAAMI-listed.

cip_cup.note: CIP maximum pressure in cup. Blank where not CIP-listed.

other.note: Free-text non-tabletted value for a handful of cartridges, e.g. a European proof figure in bar. Kept as text rather than parsed, because the units and standards are not consistent enough to coerce.

footnote.note: Marker for a note in the publisher's own table. May contain commas; keep quoted.

unit_note.note: Where the source's unit differs from the column's stated unit. The ksi columns in particular were rounded up by the compiler, so a row carrying a unit_note must not be read as a precise figure.
